# iosxr_hw_module_shutdown_8000 (Data Source)

This data source can read the HW Module Shutdown configuration on Cisco 8000 series routers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxr_hw_module_shutdown_8000" "example" {
  location = "0/0/CPU0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location string

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `admin_state` (String) Set the admin state of the hw-module
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
